howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Select a PDF up to 500 MB. The tool displays a page-count summary.

howto.name: Configure output settings
howto.text: Choose the image format (PNG, JPG, or WebP), resolution (72–600 DPI), and which pages to convert.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. Each page becomes a separate image file, delivered in a ZIP archive.

faq.a: 150 DPI is good for on-screen viewing. Use 300 DPI for printing. Higher values like 600 DPI produce large files but maximum detail.
PNG (lossless, best for text-heavy pages), JPG (smaller files, good for photos), and WebP (modern format with excellent compression).

faq.q: Can I convert just specific pages?
faq.a: Yes. Enter individual page numbers or ranges (e.g. 1-3, 7) to convert only the pages you need.
